verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents Agent Flows and custom agent skills as user-built automations, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows versioning, review/diff, or rollback of those flows. The dated changelogs and /v1 API path-versioning cover app releases and the API, not versions of a user's automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
